usedFor: Teams use 7Shifts to pull up one staff member's details with “Retrive User” and a User ID.

bestTemplate.name: “Retrive User” in 7Shifts
bestTemplate.why: It returns a specific user from a User ID, so later steps can use that person's details.

watchOut: “Retrive User” needs a User ID, so the step must be given one before it runs.
